instruction: Open https://tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/waterlevels.html?id=9414290. Request verified observed high and low water events at San Francisco for September 12-13 2025 in metres relative to MLLW and GMT. Choose H/L and apply it with Data Only. Request observed tide extrema, not predicted tides or an hourly/six-minute series. The outcome is initiation of the correctly configured observation-data request; a saved file is not required. Use Data Only to initiate the JSON observation-data request.
